svg.title: Order Reference Service planned AWS architecture
svg.desc: Customers reach optional CloudFront and an application load balancer before private ECS API containers. Cognito verifies identity. Aurora stores orders. A separate ECS publisher sends report jobs to SQS, an ECS worker writes finished reports to S3, and CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, KMS, and ECR support the environment.

g.text: The same application contract, moved to managed identity, compute, data, queue, and storage services
